apps.name: Vibefy Preview
apps.localizedDescription: Mobile preview with device-protected YouTube session restoration across app restarts, persistent local playlists and native backup export. Reconnect once after updating to enable automatic Google access renewal. Access revoked by Google requires reconnecting; reliable background YouTube playback is not guaranteed.
